purpose: Test whether one non-reusable lifetime speculative credit per request preserves one early cold-start overlap while preventing V159's whole-DAG reservation and V162's repeated late rolling admissions.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.v159_revealed_tradeoff: V159 passed the three-seed QPR sum but missed the complete-block throughput ceiling.
causal_diagnosis.v161_revealed_tradeoff: V161 restored the complete-block throughput margin but missed the complete-block QPR ceiling.
causal_diagnosis.inference: V162 proved that a one-outstanding cap prevents concurrent per-request speculative fan-out, but its reusable credit can be released and consumed again at deeper DAG levels through the final observation frame. A lifetime credit targets cumulative reservation depth rather than only instantaneous width.

frozen_thresholds.queue_density_definition: current pending plus runnable tasks divided by node count
frozen_thresholds.remaining_work_definition: sum over unfinished functions of cpu/mean_node_cpu + cold_start_frames/1000 + output_mb/1000

lifetime_credit_definition.credit_consumption: the first admitted nonterminal function that has at least one unfinished direct parent consumes the request's sole lifetime speculative credit
lifetime_credit_definition.credit_reuse: never, even after the admitted function's parents complete or the function itself completes
lifetime_credit_definition.active_state_scope: retain credited request IDs while the request exists; removing completed requests is memory cleanup and cannot enable reuse because request IDs are unique
eligible_new_candidate: the function is exposed by the unchanged PreAllSched collector
the function is nonterminal and has at least one unfinished direct parent
request remaining work is at most 5.5
current queue density is strictly below 8.0
the request has never consumed its lifetime speculative credit
lifetime_credit_definition.deterministic_selection: if multiple eligible functions appear for one request in one window, select maximum existing immutable critical-path rank, then minimum function ID

unchanged_frontiers.ready_players: all parents complete, unchanged and do not consume credit
unchanged_frontiers.terminal_pipeline_players: terminal function with all parents assigned, unchanged and do not consume credit

runtime_inputs_forbidden: a fitted time or admission-count threshold

single_mechanism_change_from_v159.nonterminal_short_players: replace unlimited incomplete-parent admission with one non-reusable lifetime speculative admission per request
unchanged: queue-density threshold 8.0 and exact V155 scoring router
SRPT request order and critical-path rank definition
NSESche solver, welfare, pricing and feasibility
common HPA, tapes, metrics and policy-independent references

valid QC, ledger, archive inventory, runtime identity and offline reference pairing

the selected candidate matches the deterministic order whenever a live same-window choice exists; absence of such a choice is reported but is not a failure because V162 already established that these frozen tapes may not expose it
congested short-work and over-work players remain rejected
terminal incomplete-parent players remain admitted at every queue density

diagnostic_selection_rule.evaluation: Replace only V155 E09, E18 and E20 with V163 and recompute the unchanged complete E01-E20 gates.
diagnostic_selection_rule.throughput_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins, including at least 2 of 3 diagnostic wins
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_mean_gate: both QPR conventions strictly greater than OCS 0.055577160345697
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins with 20 of 20 finite-only values
diagnostic_selection_rule.joint_diagnostic_pass: every listed gate passes without editing this plan
diagnostic_selection_rule.failure: retain all three valid V163 diagnostics, retire V163 and continue mechanism analysis without running the other seventeen
diagnostic_selection_rule.success: authorize a separately committed remaining-seventeen V163 training plan reusing these three rows
